title: Cardinal Billing Account State Amendatory Schedule: Late-Fee Amounts for Kentucky, Virginia and West Virginia
content:
**Schedule clause.** The late fee charge on a Cardinal Billing Account installment is figured on the late-fee amount for the governing state of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy the account bills. The late-fee amount for the governing state is $9.50 when the governing state of the auto policy is Kentucky, $12.00 when that state is Virginia or West Virginia, and the pay plan's late fee when it is any other state.

The governing state is the state recorded on the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy as the garaging state whose law governs the policy.

| Governing state on the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy | Late-fee amount |
|---|---|
| Kentucky (KY) | $9.50 |
| Virginia (VA) | $12.00 |
| West Virginia (WV) | $12.00 |
| Ohio (OH) | The pay plan's late fee |
| Indiana (IN) | The pay plan's late fee |

## Notes to the schedule

- The amount follows the policy's governing state, whatever the pay plan; a Kentucky policy carries $9.50 on every plan, and a Virginia or West Virginia policy $12.00 on every plan.
- For a policy governed by any state other than Kentucky, Virginia or West Virginia, the late-fee amount is the late fee figure of the account's own pay plan.

**Hypothetical illustration.** Two accounts on a plan with a $15.00 late fee: the one billing a Kentucky policy has a late-fee amount of $9.50, the one billing an Ohio policy $15.00.
